sections.verified:
- The root cause was parsing order: choice-text conversion tried to convert MathML before removing WIRIS annotations, and the annotation contained encoded nested MathML that broke the non-greedy `<math>...</math>` match.
- The fix sanitizes/removes WIRIS annotation content before MathML is converted into readable Unicode text.
- Regression coverage now matches the actual D2L/WIRIS cartridge shape.
- A fresh corrected Section 3.5 choice-text Google Form was created.
